question: Navneet starts from Point Y and drives 10 km towards west. He then takes a right turn, drives 18 km. He then turns right and drives 10 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 15 km and stops at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified)
solution:
• Navneet starts from Point Y and drives 10 km towards west.
 
• He then takes a right turn, drives 18 km.
 
• He then turns right and drives 10 km.
 
• He takes a final right turn, drives 15 km and stops at Point Z.
